title: Integrated communication: Public discourse — a council hearing

frames.title: Lesson 115 · Integrated communication: Public discourse — a council hearing

body: **Foco:** Comunicação integrada: Discurso público.
**Pronúncia:** Ajuste refinado de entonação.
**24 palavras novas** (discurso público).
**Texto do dia:** notícia / reportagem curta.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre audiências públicas a partir de uma notícia curta, relatando posições e decisões com entonação adequada.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: Council Defers Vote on Waterfront Tower After Marathon Hearing
paras: The city council **deferred** its vote on the proposed Harbor Tower late on Tuesday, **after more than five hours** of public testimony. **Seventy-two residents** signed up to speak; **the last** took the microphone just before midnight.

Supporters argued the project would **create jobs**, while opponents **warned** it would **block** the view of the bay and **strain** local services. Council member Lia Moreno, **who chairs** the planning committee, said further **studies were needed**, adding that she **would not be rushed**.
The hearing will **resume** on 18 June. Meanwhile, the developer has **agreed to revise** the height of the building.

items.q: The council voted on the tower on Tuesday.
Seventy-two residents signed up to speak.
The developer refuses to change the design.

blocks.body: Em notícias o verbo de relato tem **matiz**. Use **argued/warned/stressed** em vez de repetir *said*. Estrutura: *verbo + that + oração* ou *agreed to + infinitivo*.
Concordância de tempos: *said she would not be rushed* (would, não will).

items.s: The council ___ its vote until June. (defer, passado)
Opponents ___ that it would block the view. (warn, passado)
She said she ___ not be rushed. (would)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Put to a vote** — pôr em votação
**Table a proposal** — engavetar uma proposta
**Carry the motion** — aprovar a moção
**Go on record** — declarar publicamente
**Raise concerns** — levantar preocupações
**Take a stand** — posicionar-se
**Sleep on it** — refletir até amanhã
**Kick the can down the road** — adiar o problema
**Lay out a case** — expor um argumento
**Hold a hearing** — realizar uma audiência
**What did the council decide?** — O que a câmara decidiu?
**It deferred the vote after five hours.** — Adiou a votação após cinco horas.
**Who spoke against the tower?** — Quem falou contra a torre?

blocks.title: Newsroom
lines: It deferred the vote after five hours.
Adiou a votação após cinco horas.
Residents who warned about the view and services.
Moradores que alertaram sobre a vista e os serviços.

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.
words: I suppose that’s one way to put it. ↘↗ (reserva)
Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: Opponents warned that traffic would worsen.
The developer agreed to revise the height.

blocks.task: Write a 5-sentence news report about a fictional public hearing, using argued, warned and agreed to.
blocks.model: The school board deferred its decision on Monday after a three-hour hearing. Parents argued that the change would help working families. Teachers warned that classes would be overcrowded. The superintendent agreed to publish a study before the next meeting. The hearing will resume on 3 September.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
